brief:
National security minister Itamar Ben Gvir said he would displace Palestinians from the occupied West Bank and Gaza if appointed defence minister, Middle East Eye reported. The comments represent an escalation of his calls for Israeli annexation of Palestinian territories.

Ben Gvir has previously advocated for annexing the West Bank. His latest statements signal a hardening position on the displacement of Palestinians and territorial control in the occupied territories.
dek: 'The entire land is ours': Ben Gvir escalates calls for annexation of occupied West Bank Submitted by MEE staff on Sat, 10/03/2026 - 10:19 National security minister says he would displace Palestinians from the West Bank and Gaza if appointed defence minister…
title: Ben Gvir escalates calls for West Bank annexation
